verdict.rationale: The pack documents no export feature that dumps all Phoenix data (traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, annotations) in open formats. What it does show is only adjacent: self-hosting where data stays in your own infrastructure, OTLP and OpenTelemetry for ingesting traces, and SDK or MCP querying of spans and projects. These are data-residency and developer building blocks, not an export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
